scope: Bounded repair of the one-degree-of-freedom unilateral penalty contact reference module only. Node mathematical reference; not production 3D contact, friction, bolt, Tet4, worker, schema, UI or browser verification.

problem.reviewObservation: maxIterations was validated with Number.isInteger only, so 1e20 was accepted; with toleranceN=1e-30 the Newton residual stalls near 8.5265e-14 N because next === u after rounding, and the loop does not return.

iterationBudget.kind: computational resource ceiling, not a physical convergence threshold
rationale: The reference fixture in tests/unilateral-contact-reference.test.mjs and the documented reference values use maxIterations=50 and need only 3 active-set iterations for the contact case.
Other bounded solvers in this repository cap iterations at 100 (modal-core), 2500 (pcg/gpu-pcg) and 5000 (stokes-core); a scalar 1-DOF Newton reference never needs more.
10000 is therefore a strict upper bound above all existing usage while still bounding CPU time; larger safe integers are refused instead of merely allowing MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
iterationBudget.validation: Number.isSafeInteger plus 1 <= maxIterations <= 10000; 0/negative/fraction/Infinity/NaN/1e20/10001/MAX_SAFE_INTEGER -> CONTACT_MAX_ITERATIONS_INVALID with details.limit=10000

stagnationHandling.policy: A non-finite residual, tangent or iterate is refused as CONTACT_NON_FINITE with finite-only details. A finite next===u or a next iterate already seen is refused as CONTACT_NOT_CONVERGED with details.reason='stagnation'. The seen-iterate set is bounded by the 10000 iteration budget. A state that does not satisfy toleranceN is never returned as converged.
stagnationHandling.existingCodeCompatibility: CONTACT_NOT_CONVERGED and all pre-existing input refusal codes are retained; the iteration-limit refusal adds details.reason='iteration-limit' without changing its code.
